structuralRepair.salesBoundary: Classifies explicit commercial opt-out separately from browsing/non-purchase language. A model stop remains available for unlisted-language opt-outs, but a current browsing-only signal such as 見るだけ or 今日は買わない cannot itself create persistent salesStopped. Explicit 商品を勧めないで remains an opt-out.
structuralRepair.requestActionCompletion: For a current positive, referential listen/read/open request, attach a card only for the latest eligible previously recommended work of the same medium with an existing public link. It refuses link/card declines, action retractions, changed references, active stop, rejected works, missing links, and absent specific references.
structuralRepair.sampleScope: The repair labels a link as a public link. It does not claim a particular sample/preview was delivered or establish its contents.
structuralRepair.priorOptOutRevocation: A persisted explicit opt-out can be set aside only when the current user text contains a product, price, purchase, delivery, refund, rights, or gift inquiry. This is a narrow factual scope and not general sales reopening.

trace.purpose: Make an otherwise actionable direct experience omission inspectable without inventing a recommendation.

validation.helperAssertions: PASS: explicit opt-out versus browsing; action link completion; no-link decline; retracted action; rejected prior work; actual p-long turn 16 classified as a music action request; commerce inquiry scope.
validation.typecheck: Candidate-wide tsc reports pre-existing unrelated missing generated files/window.posthog errors. Filtering its output found no count-action-completion or count-semantic-turn diagnostic.

remaining: No provider run or customer outcome was performed.
A public streaming/store link is not proof of a specific preview, playback success, availability, or listener satisfaction.
The parent owns prompt/architecture integration decisions and final judgment.
